title: Eustathius of Thessalonica, Parekbolai on the Iliad: unit Proem + Book 1 / Евстафий Солунский, Комментарий к «Илиаде»
author: Eustathius of Thessalonica
size: Van der Valk: 4 vols (est. ~3,000 pp.; ~0.8–1M words). Pilot: est. ~20k words.
edition: Van der Valk 1971–87 (Brill, in copyright). Stallbaum 1827–30 (Leipzig) is PD.
ru_evidence: Ru-wiki 'Евстафий Солунский' lists only the editions and studies (Kazhdan; Pravoslavnaya Entsiklopediya), with no translation of the commentaries.
en_evidence: English Wikipedia and the search: only the preface has been translated (Jenkins, Bachrach and Hayton, Notre Dame 2002). The Odyssey commentary, books 1–8, is in English (Cullhed and Olson, Brill 2022–23; BMCR 2023.11.38).
other_translations: Latin: Politi 1730 (Il. 1–5). No modern full translation found.
value: The summa of Byzantine Homeric learning. Preserves lost scholia, Atticist lexica and historians, and documents 12th-c. pedagogy and the reception of antiquity. A major gap in both Russian and English.
ai_feasibility: Medium-low. Long periods, dense intertext and etymological play. Needs aggressive source-tracing agents and expert review.
pilot_unit: Prooimion plus commentary on Iliad 1.1–100; est. ~20k words.
